t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnome's worth changes over time. Certain colours will give you less mushrooms for some time and then this can change. I should hopefully be obvious if I realise another colour has dropped in value

vb_textbox.text: Good gnomes are ones that give you 5-6 mushrooms. The worth of gnomes change over time, for example, pink can be good for a period of time, but then later on green may be the better choice, so keep an eye on this with trial and error or if you think something has changed. I feel after the breaks, the rules change, and the colours associated with good worth before have been flipped around. Good luck!
